segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ נָטַל אֶבֶן אוֹ קוֹרָה שֶׁל הֶקְדֵּשׁ – הֲרֵי זֶה לֹא מָעַל.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» In a case where «one took» for his use «a consecrated stone or a beam, that» person «is not liable for» its «misuse.»

segments.he: נְתָנָהּ לַחֲבֵרוֹ – הוּא מָעַל, וַחֲבֵרוֹ לֹא מָעַל. בְּנָאָהּ בְּתוֹךְ בֵּיתוֹ – הֲרֵי זֶה לֹא מָעַל, עַד שֶׁיָּדוּר תַּחְתֶּיהָ בְּשָׁוֶה פְּרוּטָה.
segments.en: If «he gave» the stone or the beam «to another, he is liable for» its «misuse and the other» person «is not liable for» its «misuse.» If «he built» the stone or the beam «into his house, he is not liable for» its «misuse until he resides beneath it» and derives benefit equal to «the value of one peruta» from it.

segments.he: נָטַל פְּרוּטָה שֶׁל הֶקְדֵּשׁ – הֲרֵי זֶה לֹא מָעַל. נְתָנָהּ לַחֲבֵרוֹ – הוּא מָעַל, וַחֲבֵרוֹ לֹא מָעַל. נְתָנָהּ לְבַלָּן, אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁלֹּא רָחַץ מָעַל, שֶׁהוּא אוֹמֵר לוֹ: הֲרֵי הַמֶּרְחָץ פָּתוּחַ לְפָנֶיךָ, הִכָּנֵס וּרְחוֹץ.
segments.en: If «one took» for his use «a consecrated peruta, that» person «is not liable for» its «misuse.» If «he gave» the peruta «to another, he is liable for» its «misuse and the other» person «is not liable for» its «misuse.» If «he gave» the peruta «to a bathhouse attendant [levallan], although he did not bathe, he is liable for misuse» of the peruta. The reason is «that» at the moment he receives the peruta, the attendant in effect «says to» the owner of the peruta: «The bathhouse is open before you, enter and bathe.» The benefit derived from that availability is worth one peruta.

segments.he: אֲכִילָתוֹ וַאֲכִילַת חֲבֵרוֹ, הֲנָיָיתוֹ וַהֲנָיַית חֲבֵרוֹ, אֲכִילָתוֹ וַהֲנָיַית חֲבֵרוֹ, הֲנָיָיתוֹ וַאֲכִילַת חֲבֵרוֹ – מִצְטָרְפִין זֶה עִם זֶה, וַאֲפִילּוּ לִזְמַן מְרוּבֶּה.
segments.en: «One’s consumption» of half of a peruta of consecrated food «and another’s consumption» of half of a peruta of consecrated food that the first person fed him; and likewise «one’s benefit» of half of a peruta derived from a consecrated item «and another’s benefit» of half of a peruta derived from a consecrated item that the first person provided him; and similarly «one’s consumption and another’s benefit» derived or «one’s benefit» derived «and another’s consumption,» all these «join together» to constitute the requisite measure of one peruta for liability for misuse, «and» that is the halakha «even if much time» has passed between these various acts of consumption and deriving of benefit.

moves.cueHe: נטל אבן או קורה של הקדש
moves.summary: taking a consecrated stone or beam is not misuse
giving to another is misuse; building in only after residing a peruta's worth
same for a peruta; giving to bath attendant is misuse
one's and another's consumption/benefit combine even over time

positions.claim: taking is not misuse; giving to another is; building in only upon residing; paying a bath attendant is misuse; consumption and benefit of self and other combine
